reviewedEvidence.evidence: SQLitePCLRaw.lib.e_sqlite3 3.53.3 LICENSE.txt; SHA-256 99464c3a88df7b708ce59e462cdcb85f72dfc9b1335b4fcc68be56131b634b95; the package identifies its native SQLite builds, states that SQLite is public domain, and links https://sqlite.org/copyright.html
